body.statement: For every \(\mathcal M\subseteq\mathcal G^{\mathrm{WARP}}_3\) with \(\mathcal S_3\subseteq\mathcal M\), the vector \((\mu_t^\star)_{t\in\mathcal B}\) is outcome-nonrestrictively identified on \(\mathcal M\) if and only if \(\mathcal M\subseteq\mathcal E_3\). Consequently \(\mathcal E_3\) is the unique inclusion-maximal such support. Relative to the coordinate-separable support \(\mathcal S_3\) of Blackwell and Pashley, this strictly enlarges the admissible response family from eight to 29 maps while preserving the same eight perfect-complier means.
body.justification: The iff statement identifies the largest economically rational relaxation rather than offering another sufficient compliance restriction.
body.gap: Blackwell--Pashley impose coordinate-specific receipt, while Goff supplies a generic criterion and a two-factor boundary rather than this three-factor maximal support.
body.consumer: The theorem tells factorial-IV analysts exactly which interactive uptake behaviors leave every perfect-complier factorial estimand intact.
